family.name: pp_airfoil
family.title: Cambered Joukowski airfoil: surface Cp over camber, thickness and incidence
family.domain: aerodynamics / UAV, wind and compressor sections

reference.name: Joukowski conformal map with the Kutta condition (exact potential flow)
reference.citation: Milne-Thomson, Theoretical Hydrodynamics, 5th ed. (1968), ch. 6 (the Joukowski transformation); Anderson, Fundamentals of Aerodynamics, ch. 4 (Kutta condition and Kutta-Joukowski theorem)
assumptions: incompressible, inviscid, irrotational: no boundary layer, no separation, no drag from pressure
a cusped trailing edge, so the Kutta condition applies and the circulation is fixed by it

split.policy: random by geometry, fixed by the seed: a held-out body is never a training body

ensemble_spread.note: standard deviation between the bagged ensemble heads, not a confidence level

probes.name: a 36% thick section, four times the trained thickness
reasons: geometry 10.81x farther from the training designs than usual

probes.name: an 18% camber, three times the trained camber
reasons: geometry 3.90x farther from the training designs than usual

ood.threshold: the library's own: geometry-code distance over the 95th percentile of the training nearest-neighbour distances, above 1.5x
ood.note: reported as measured: a probe the model does not flag is not thereby inside its validity domain

measured_here: held-out relative L2 0.4954 on 4 designs of 480 points, tolerance 0.05
constant-field baseline on the same designs: 0.9655
OOD: 2/2 probes outside the family flagged, 2/4 held-out designs flagged
not_measured: the reference itself: analytic — Joukowski conformal map with the Kutta condition (exact potential flow), with the assumptions it lists
agreement with a solver or with measured data for any geometry of this family
whether the ensemble spread is calibrated: it is the spread between bootstrap heads
behaviour outside the declared geometry and operating bounds of the family
